definitions.explanation: Pertaining to or connected with the study or events of the past.
Of great significance in history, momentous.

notes:
{歴史的|れきしてき} has two uses: describing something related to history, or emphasizing historical significance.

WORD FORMATION:
⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧ (history) + {的|てき} (adjectival suffix)

FORMS:
- Na-adjective: {歴史的|れきしてき}な + noun
- Adverb: {歴史的|れきしてき}に

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {歴史的|れきしてき}⟦{建造物|けんぞうぶつ}→建造物：24301_kenzoubutsu⟧: historic building
- {歴史的|れきしてき}⟦{事実|じじつ}→事実：03271_jijitsu⟧: historical fact
- {歴史的|れきしてき}⟦{背景|はいけい}→背景：28348_haikei⟧: historical background
- {歴史的|れきしてき}⟦{瞬間|しゅんかん}→瞬間：03226_shunkan⟧: historic moment

NUANCE:
Sense 1 (relating to history) is neutral. Sense 2 (historic/momentous) carries a positive or significant connotation.
